mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% (based on 10-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate earnings growth expectations decline, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE increased by >0.5pp over 3 months (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1.0% in the prior month signal a contraction in consumer spending, leading to expectations of lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 1.0% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1.0% in 1 month (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above 105 (indicating a high-growth supply regime), a decline in industrial output exceeding 0.5% in the following month signals an imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 105 and INDPRO declines >0.5% in 1 month (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises >0.3pp in 1 month (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 5-year moving average indicates a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 5-year moving average (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary demand regime (GDPC1 growth rate negative), a negative GDP growth rate signals worsening economic conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: recessionary demand regime (GDPC1 growth rate negative)
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate is negative (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% in the prior month signal a contraction in both manufacturing and construction sectors, indicating a broad economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST decline by >0.5% in 1 month (based on 10-year rolling window).
